# Lightweight Charts 5.2.0

Pinned standalone production ESM; no CDN request at runtime.

- Source: https://unpkg.com/lightweight-charts@5.2.0/dist/lightweight-charts.standalone.production.mjs
- SHA-256: `66ac22df1b08de08ec2fae2b401b0f9731a4653a28e18a9837c7c3553c33dbe2`
- Package metadata: https://unpkg.com/lightweight-charts@5.2.0/package.json

- NOTICE: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tradingview/lightweight-charts/v5.2.0/NOTICE
- Upstream: https://github.com/tradingview/lightweight-charts/tree/v5.2.0

The standalone asset includes fancy-canvas; bundled license comments are retained.
The page displays the TradingView attribution link and chart attribution logo.
This release is used for candles/volume and exact-price markers in the HPG run
chart (atPriceMiddle + fill_price). The separate VN30F1M market-snapshot page
does not have executed fills or equity yet.
